question: Xadiisku waa hadalka kuma?
explanation: Xadiis waa hadal Nebi Muxammad ﷺ yidhi ama wax uu sameeyay. Qur'aanku waa hadalka Alle.

question: Yaa Nebiga ﷺ arkay oo xadiiska xifdiyay?
explanation: Saxaabi waa qof Nebiga ﷺ arkay oo rumeeyay, sida Abuu Hurayrah. Isagaa xadiiska xifdiyay.

question: Kee baa kitaab xadiis ah?
explanation: Bukhaari iyo Muslim waa labada kitaab ee ugu caansan xadiiska.

question: Maxaan nidhaahnaa ka hor inta aynaan cuntada cunin?
explanation: Nebigu ﷺ wuxuu wiilkii yar ku yidhi: sammillaah — magaca Alle ku bilow. (Bukhaari 5376 iyo Muslim 2022)

question: Gacantee ayaan wax ku cunnaa?
explanation: Xadiisku wuxuu leeyahay wa kul bi-yamiinik — gacanta midig ku cun.

question: Immisa jeer ayuu Nebigu ﷺ hooyo sheegay ka hor aabbe?
explanation: Wuxuu yidhi: hooyadaa, hooyadaa, hooyadaa, dabadeedna aabbahaa. (Bukhaari 5971 iyo Muslim 2548)

question: Daahirnimadu waa immisa iimaanka?
explanation: At-tuhuuru shatrul-iimaan — daahirnimadu waa nus iimaanka. (Muslim 223)

question: Dhoola-cadeyntaadu waa maxay?
explanation: Tabassumuka fii wajhi akhiika laka sadaqah — dhoola-cadeyntaadu waa sadaqo. (Tirmidhi 1956)

question: Haddaad dhagax ama qodax jidka ka qaaddo, maxay noqonaysaa?
explanation: Isla xadiiskii dhoola-cadeynta ayaa leh: dhibaatada jidka ka qaadiddaadu waa sadaqo. (Tirmidhi 1956)

question: Marka hadalkaagu wanaagsanayn, maxaad samaynaysaa?
explanation: Falyaqul khayran aw liyasmut — ha yidhaahdo wanaag ama ha aamuso. (Bukhaari 6018 iyo Muslim 47)

question: Kee baa deriska dhibaya?
explanation: Falaa yu'dhi jaarah — deriskiisa yuusan dhibin. Buuqu wuxuu ka hor istaagaa hurdadooda.

question: Marka marti gurigiinna timaaddo, maxaad samaynaysaa?
options: Waan soo dhawaynayaa oo fadhi baan siinayaa
explanation: Falyukrim dayfah — martidiisa ha sharfo. (Bukhaari 6018 iyo Muslim 47)

question: Qofka aan naxariisan maxaa ku dhacaya?
explanation: Man laa yarham laa yurham — qofka aan naxariisan lama naxariisto. (Bukhaari 5997 iyo Muslim 2318)

question: Bisad gaajaysan ayaa albaabka joogta. Maxaad samaynaysaa?
explanation: Ar-raahimuuna yarhamuhumur-Rahmaan — kuwa naxariista, Raxmaan baa u naxariista. (Tirmidhi 1924)

question: Labada shay ee xadiisku sheegay in dadku ka nabad galaan waa carrabka iyo maxay?
explanation: Al-muslimu man salimal-muslimuuna min lisaanihi wa yadih — carrabkiisa iyo gacantiisa. (Bukhaari 10 iyo Muslim 40)

question: Laba canjeero ayaa saxanka yaal: mid weyn iyo mid yar. Xadiisku maxuu ku leeyahay?
options: Walaalkaa sii tan aad adigu jeceshahay
explanation: Laa yu'minu ahadukum hattaa yuhibba li-akhiihi maa yuhibbu li-nafsih — walaalkaa u jeclow waxaad naftaada u jeceshahay. (Bukhaari 13 iyo Muslim 45)

question: Xadiiska ugu horreeya kitaabka Bukhari waa kee?
explanation: Xadiiska niyadaha — Bukhari 1, wuxuu weriyay Cumar bin Al-Khaddaab.

question: "Innamal-acmaalu bin-niyyaat" macnihiisu waa?
options: Camalladu waxay ku xiran yihiin niyadaha
explanation: Camal kasta qiimihiisu wuxuu ku jiraa niyada qalbiga.

question: Xadiiska Buniyal-islaam — Islaamka maxaa lagu mataley?
explanation: Bukhari 8, Muslim 16: Islaamka waxaa lagu dhisay shan.

question: Ninkii dharka cadcad ee su'aalaha weydiiyay yuu ahaa?
explanation: Muslim 8: kaasi waa Jibriil — wuxuu idiin yimid inuu diintiinna idin baro.

question: Waa maxay Ixsaanku?
options: Inaad Alle u caabuddo sida adiga oo arka — isaguna wuu ku arkaa
explanation: Jawaabta saddexaad ee xadiiska Jibriil (Muslim 8).

question: Xadiiska Nucmaan bin Bashiir — maxaa u dhexeeya xalaasha iyo xaraanta?
explanation: Bukhari 52: dhexdooda waxaa ah waxyaabo isku shabahsan — kan iska ilaaliya, diintiisa ayuu dhawray.

question: "Ad-diinun-nasiixah" — diintu waa maxay?
explanation: Muslim 55 — shan qaybood: Alle, kitaabkiisa, rasuulkiisa, hoggaamiyayaasha iyo guudka muslimiinta.

question: Quruxda Islaamka qofku waa?
options: Inuu ka tago waxa aan isaga khusayn
explanation: Tirmidhi 2317 (xasan): min xusni islaamil-mar'i tarkuhu maa laa yacniih.

question: Labada magac ee xadiiska runta: run-sheegaha iyo beenaalaha joogtada ah?
explanation: Bukhari 6094: runta ku dadaashadu Siddiiq, beenta ku dadaashadu kadhdhaab.

question: Mu'minku mu'minka waa sida...?
options: Dhismo — qaybtiisu qaybta kale way adkaysaa
explanation: Bukhari 481: kal-bunyaan — Nebigu ﷺ faruhuu isdhex geliyay markuu sheegayay.

question: Saddexda xaq ee xadiiska Bukhari 6018 waa?
options: Hadal khayr ah ama aamusnaan, deriska, martida
explanation: Saddexduba waxay ku xiran yihiin: kan rumaysan Alle iyo maalinta dambe.

question: Qofka hindhisa oo "Alxamdulillaah" yiraahda — maxaad ku tiraahdaa?
explanation: Muslim 2162: mid ka mid ah lixda xaq — u ducee: Alle ha kuu naxariisto.

question: "Qul aamantu billaahi thumma..." — dhammee.
explanation: Muslim 38: dheh Alle waan rumeeyay, kaddibna istiqaamo — joogtee jidka toosan.

question: Xadiiska qaybtiisa "Waxaa ii sheegay Maalik, kana Naafic, kana Ibnu Cumar" waa?
explanation: Sanadku waa silsiladda weriyayaasha; matnku waa hadalka qudhiisa.

question: Saddexda marxaladood ee xadiisku soo maray si uu inoo gaaro?
explanation: Xusuusta asxaabta, qoriddii rasmiga ahayd, kaddibna ururintii kutubta.

question: Darajada ugu sarreysa xadiiska waa?
explanation: Saxiix: sanad buuxa oo weriye kastaa run-sheege xafid wanaagsan yahay.

question: Waa maxay xadiiska mawduuca?
options: Been-abuur Nebiga ﷺ lagu sheegay — waa la diidaa
explanation: Mawduucu waa hadal la sameeyay — faafintiisu waa dembi.

question: "Man kadhaba calayya mutacammidan..." — kan si kas ah been Nebiga ﷺ ugu sheega, maxaa loogu goodiyay?
explanation: Bukhari 110, Muslim 3 — xadiis mutawaatir ah.

question: Imaam Bukhaari kitaabkiisa immisa sano buu ku qaatay?
explanation: 16 sano — xadiis kasta ka horna weeso iyo laba rakco.

question: "Labada Saxiix" waa kuwee?
explanation: Saxiixul-Bukhaari iyo Saxiix Muslim — kutubta ugu saxsan Qur'aanka kaddib.

question: War baa kuu yimid. Su'aasha ugu horreysa ee hubinta waa?
explanation: Al-Xujuraat 6 iyo habka culimada xadiiska: isha warka ayaa la baaraa marka hore.

question: "Khayrukum man tacallamal-Qur'aana wa callamah" — labada fal ee isku xiran waa?
explanation: Bukhari 5027: kan barta OO bara — darajada ugu sarreysa waa labada isku dar.

question: Kan jid u mara cilmi-doonis, maxaa Alle u fududeeyaa?
explanation: Muslim 2699 — malaa'igtuna baalashooda bay u dhigaan cilmi-doonka.

question: Saddexda camal ee aan go'in qofka dhintay kaddib waa?
options: Sadaqo jaariya, cilmi la faa'iidaysto, ilmo saalix ah oo u ducaynaya
explanation: Muslim 1631 — adiguna waxaad tahay qaybta saddexaad: ilmaha saalixa ah.

question: Toddobada hooska Alle — qaybta dhallinyarada waa tee?
explanation: Bukhari 660, Muslim 1031 — fursaddaada gaarka ah da'daadan.
